description: This file is a shell script utilizing awk for IP address calculations, including conversions, subnet calculations, and range determinations.

methods.name: bitcount
methods.description: Counts the number of bits set to 1 in a 32-bit integer.

methods.name: ip2int
methods.description: Converts an IP address string to a 32-bit integer.

methods.name: int2ip
methods.description: Converts a 32-bit integer to an IP address string.

methods.name: compl32
methods.description: Calculates the 32-bit ones' complement of a given value.
